events.title: Steam Next Fest is live: play the free Crack & Collect demo!
events.summary: Next Fest is live! events.title: Crack & Collect comes out on November 12!
events.summary: See you on November 12 We finally have a date! Crack & Collect comes out on Steam on November 12, 2026. What's waiting in the full game The demo is the first day of the game. The full game adds new days, more upgrades, new ways to earn money, new egg and figurine catalogs and new goals. Before the release The free demo is already on Steam, and from October 19 to 26 we're in Steam Next Fest.
